issue_records.title: NL File format: "Method Error: convert(Expr, Float64)" when trying to parse V section of NL file
issue_records.body_excerpt:
When trying to parse an NL file with the latest commit of MOI, it throws a method error at [this line](https://github.com/jump-dev/MathOptInterface.jl/blob/master/src/FileFormats/NL/read.jl#L501), while trying to convert a `Float64` to an `Expr`.
What is surprising to me is that when this parsing function wasn't implemented yet, the file was loaded without issue.

Here is a list of files where this occurs:
- [deconvc.nl](https://github.com/GiovanniKarra/CUTE.jl/blob/main/data/NL/deconvc.nl)
- [deconvu.nl](https://github.com/GiovanniKarra/CUTE.jl/blob/main/data/NL/deconvu.nl)
- [deconvb.nl](https://github.com/GiovanniKarra/CUTE.jl/blob/main/data/NL/deconvb.nl)

Corresponding AMPL mod files if you find it useful:
- [deconvc.mod](https://github.com/GiovanniKarra/CUTE.jl/blob/main/data/AMPL/deconvc.mod)
- [deconvu.mod](https://github.com/GiovanniKarra/CUTE.jl/blob/main/data/AMPL/deconvu.mod)
- [deconvb.mod](https://github.com/GiovanniKarra/CUTE.jl/blob/main/data/AMPL/deconvb.mod)

issue_records.title: [FileFormats.NL] fix reading defined variables that are not expressions
issue_records.body_excerpt:
Closes #2979

It didn't occur to me that defined variables might be something other than an expression.
